//: Deployment config for the SanctiWalk Firebase project.
firestore.rules and storage.rules were written long ago and have never
been deployable, because `firebase deploy` needs this file and .firebaserc
and neither existed. That is why parishContent reads fail with 'Missing or
insufficient permissions' while the rules file plainly says
`allow read: if true` - the file was never in force.
The AI Studio project used a NAMED database; this one uses (default).
The Firebase CLI deploys Firestore rules to (default) unless told
otherwise, so deploying without this line would write the rules to an
empty database nobody uses and change nothing about the real one - while
reporting success. The name comes from firestoreDatabaseId in
firebase-applet-config.json, which is what src/lib/firebase.ts connects to.
